description: Output-contains branch of Heritage::tryOutputStackGuard (heritage.cc:1406-1430, the fourth justifiedContain touchpoint at cc:1420): six trigger geometries driven directly with a locked stack output (justified / unjustified +2 / far-end +4 / size==retSize no-SUBPIECE / pre-existing output reuse / vnFinal-null no-op with empty write and cc:1430 true), full op projection with SUBPIECE in[1] constants, caller-perspective translation of the return storage, write-list {ah} entries, plus the exact cc:1420 LE/BE call-shape constants
architecture: locked synthetic LE 64-bit Architecture: const=0, other=1, unique=2, ram=3, register=4, stack=5 (spacebase over ram), ram_be=6 (big-endian), iop=7; stack delay=1
compiler_spec: synthetic prototype fixture: tryoutputguard (inputs RSI 0x30/RDI 0x38, output RAX 0x0 — model entries inert for the locked-output characterization); the guarded call carries a locked non-void output whose storage Address is the stack spacebase at callee 0x1000:8 (ParameterPieces typelock + setOutputLock + setStackOutputLock, the coreaction.cc:1546-1549 shape) with stackoffset 0x10 caller/callee rebase

analysis_options.boundary: direct drive of the production Heritage::tryOutputStackGuard output-contains branch (heritage.cc:1406-1430) with outputCharacter derived through the production FuncProto::characterizeAsOutput locked branch (fspec.cc:4339-4353) on the C++ side and staged with the same cc:4346 math on the Rust side
analysis_options.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators over architecture, compiler_spec, analysis_options, and cases
analysis_options.staging: the cc:1407/cc:1410 fc->getOutput() reads are staged on the Rust side through the locked_output_storage parameter Some((Address(0x1000), retSize)) — the same (Address,size) the C++ oracle derives from its locked ProtoParameter; production passes None (FSPEC-OUTPUT-STORAGE-0001)

comparand.rust_crate_tree_hash_scheme: sha256 of rugra-heritage-tryoutput-d0-base-overlay-v1 plus base commit and sorted length-prefixed paths and contents

coverage.output_contains_branch: MATCH: six geometries through the production Heritage::tryOutputStackGuard output-contains branch (heritage.cc:1406-1430) — op order (CALL then opInsertAfter'd SUBPIECE, cc:1424), inputs/outputs per op, write-list entries with the vnFinal-only active-heritage flag (cc:1426-1429), and the cc:1430 return value true on every geometry including the no-op
coverage.cc1420_truncate_constant: MATCH: the fourth justifiedContain touchpoint retAddr.justifiedContain(retSize, addr, size, false) — LE start distances 0/2/4 (SUBPIECE in[1] constants c4(0)/c4(2)/c4(4) in the drive projection) and the BE end distances 4/2/0 pinned by case=cc1420_constant
coverage.missing_outvn_creation: MATCH: cc:1413-1416 — the call output is created at (caller-perspective retAddr, retSize) only when callOp->getOut() is null; the created varnode is written but not active-heritage when the SUBPIECE overwrites vnFinal
coverage.preexisting_outvn_reuse: MATCH: cc:1411-1412 — a pre-existing call output is reused as SUBPIECE in[0] (geom 4) with no second output created
coverage.vnfinal_null_noop: MATCH: cc:1426 guard — a pre-existing output with size==retSize (geom 5) creates no ops, leaves the write list empty, and cc:1430 still returns true
coverage.caller_perspective_translation: MATCH: cc:1407-1410 — the callee-perspective locked storage 0x1000 is translated by diff = addr - transAddr = 0x10 to the caller perspective 0x1010 (the created output varnode offset and the retc header field)
coverage.production_entry_wiring: UNTESTED: the production guardCalls entry (heritage.cc:1487-1491) passes None for locked_output_storage because Rugra's FuncProto keeps no proto-store output storage (set_output_parameter discards pieces.addr, FSPEC-OUTPUT-STORAGE-0001); the conservative false keeps the unknown_effect INDIRECT guard. Until that residual lands, the production entry cannot reach the ported branch and the direct-drive comparand stages the same (Address, retSize) the C++ oracle derives from fc->getOutput()
coverage.be_stack_space: UNTESTED: a big-endian spacebase space cannot be staged in Rugra's transitional AddressSpace enum (Stack is LE, is_big_endian() is a constant false), so the BE routing of cc:1420 is pinned only at helper level (case=cc1420_constant), mirroring the heritage_subpiece_const_1204 convention
